This page summarizes solver results per model family. Tables are generated
from `experiments/**/summary.csv` files by
`scripts/generate_results_tables.py` — run that script and re-render the site
to refresh them (do not hand-edit content between the `AUTO-GENERATED`
markers below, it will be overwritten).

Only the SK family is shown for now; other families are commented out below
(wrapped in `.content-hidden` divs) until there's real data for them.
